findings.detail: Footnote-derived nonaccrual flags attached to equity and other investment rows with no debt coupon or interest-rate fields.

citation.quoted_text: Mitnick TA Aggregator, LP (11)(12)(13) | Membership Interest ( 0.43 % ownership) | 5/2/2022 | 5,243 | 5,245 | 0.4 %

rationale: The bundle's eight nonaccrual artifact rows are sourced from footnotes, but the raw schedule rows checked are equity/other investments such as membership interests, class units, and common shares. These cited rows have blank reference-rate and interest-rate columns and are not debt accrual-status disclosures. The rule fire therefore reflects footnote/classification lookthrough leakage into nonaccrual detection rather than true nonaccrual debt positions. Literal non-accrual text was not found by targeted roam searches, so the decision is grounded in the schedule row structure and cited rows.
